Downtown Anchorage.name: Downtown Anchorage
Downtown Anchorage.description: The 4th Avenue/City Hall core on the Knik Arm shoreline with office-to-residential conversions, the waterfront redevelopment arc, and the state government office base.

South Addition.name: South Addition
South Addition.description: The 1910s grid south of downtown around the Delaney Park Strip with craftsman and art-deco stock, small-lot infill, and the West Anchorage restaurant row.

Midtown.name: Midtown
Midtown.description: The C Street/Northern Lights office-retail node between downtown and the airport with 1980s commercial stock cycling toward multifamily conversion.

Rogers Park.name: Rogers Park
Rogers Park.description: The post-war tract grid east of the Debarr corridor around Rogers Park Elementary with steady renovation trades and duplex conversion pressure.

Russian Jack.name: Russian Jack
Russian Jack.description: The northeast hills around Russian Jack Springs Park with 1960s-70s subdivisions, deep starter-home turnover, and the Muldoon-edge rental register.

Sand Lake.name: Sand Lake
Sand Lake.description: The lake-country southwest around the airport was with mid-century ramblers, floatplane-adjacent lots, and steady executive teardown/rebuild.

Turnagain.name: Turnagain
Turnagain.description: The bluff-top residential arm west of Spenard with Cook Inlet views, chunky 1950s-60s stock, and renovation-led permit flow near Kincaid.

Eagle River & Chugiak.name: Eagle River & Chugiak
Eagle River & Chugiak.description: The Glenn Highway bedroom corridor from Eagle River through Chugiak to Eklutna with 12,927 live assessor parcels, JBER-driven demand, and large-lot subdivision growth.
